name: ChatGPT Projects
desc: A container for one piece of work's files and chats.
desc_zh: 把一件事的文件和对话收在一处的容器。
solves: Same brief uploaded again, same constraints re-explained again. A project holds the files, instructions, and history for one body of work.
solves_zh: 同一份 brief 反复上传，同样的约束反复解释。项目把一件事的文件、指令和历史放在一起。
best_for: One ongoing thing — a client, a paper, a codebase — spread across many separate chats.
best_for_zh: 长期推进同一件事——一个客户、一篇论文、一个代码库——却散在很多段对话里。
notes: 集成在 ChatGPT 内的能力。来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/10169521-projects-in-chatgpt
